scenes.purpose: Open on one plain goal and the promise of turning it into steps, so the film starts from the work rather than from feature chrome.
Land the actual MiniMax Code screen full frame so every later beat rests on real product material.
Step one of the workflow: the goal is written in the real message input area.
Step two: the single goal becomes ordered next steps, shown on the real suggestion chips.
Name the described Coding and Work modes and agents teaming up with the attribution carried in the header, so no claim reads as a measured result.
Resolve on the supplied call to action with room to read the label and the URL.

treatment.continuity: One continuous move over a single official MiniMax Code interface image: a short hook with a supporting line hands off to the full workspace, then two pushes isolate the message input and the suggestion chips as the goal becomes ordered steps, before attributed claim cards and the supplied end card. Headlines are cut short enough to sit on one or two lines at reading size, the palette and Geist Sans come from the interface, and each capability is worded as MiniMax's own description with no outcome, speed, price or ranking. Asset is internal-eval scope only, not cleared for public render.
